capture_command.label: Input capture command
capture_command.description: Shell command whose output is parsed for keyboard and touchpad events. Change it only if libinput needs different arguments.

spacing.label: Symbol spacing
spacing.description: Gap between the modifier and key symbols, in pixels.

width.label: Symbol slot width
width.description: Fixed width of each symbol slot, in pixels. A fixed slot keeps the widget from resizing as different keys are pressed. Increase it if wide glyphs get clipped.

font.label: Symbol font family
font.description: Font family used for the symbols. Leave empty to use the bar's font. The family must be installed on the system.

active_color.label: Highlight color
active_color.description: Color used while a modifier key or key press is highlighted.

inactive_color.label: Idle color
inactive_color.description: Color used for symbols that are not currently highlighted.

modifier.label: Modifier Key Symbols
modifier.desc: Customize modifier key display symbols (JSON, e.g. {"super":"⌘"}). Key names are case-insensitive.

fade.label: Highlight hold time (ms)
fade.description: How long pressed modifier keys and gestures stay highlighted after release.

retention.label: Statistics retention (days)
retention.description: Daily key statistics older than this are deleted.

show_gesture.label: Show gestures
show_gesture.description: Show trackpad gestures and pointer motion in the bar.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.clearConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear all statistics? This cannot be undone.
